Castellan’s Creed
“

Fires a short-ranged superheated blast of thermal energy that melts the heaviest armor and thickest chitin into slag.

The 40-K Meltagun is a Stratagem that calls down a Support Weapon that fires a superheated beam of thermal energy, dealing massive damage and penetrating through large amounts of armor.

Procurement

The 40-K Meltagun is unlocked on the 3rd page of the Castellan’s Creed Legendary Warbond for 110 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • The Meltagun fires a continuous beam like the LAS-98 Laser Cannon but trades range and unlimited ammo for massive DPS and higher armor penetration. However, unlike other beam-firing laser weapons, the Meltagun does not set enemies on fire.
  • The Meltagun has a short charge-up time before firing, leaving a short window of vulnerability for users. To effectively fire it, Helldivers should maintain some distance between enemies in order to charge up the weapon and land shots.
  • Once the Meltagun is charged, it fires continuously for roughly 1.4 seconds before needing to be charged again, dealing a maximum theoretical damage of 3,640 per burst.
    • The Meltagun, however, suffers from damage fall-off, which is unique for beam weapons. 40% of damage is lost at its maximum range of 15 meters — dealing ~1,560 DPS.
  • With 3 rounds per magazine and 4 spares, the Meltagun can be fired 15 times before running empty.
    • This can be alleviated by equipping armor with the Siege-Ready passive, adding one more spare magazine.
  • The Meltagun is extremely effective against heavy enemies such as Annihilator Tanks, Chargers, and Fleshmobs, killing them in 1 to 2 shots anywhere on their body.
    • Massive enemies can be destroyed with 1 to 2 shots to their weak spots, such as a Factory Strider's belly panels and a Bile Titan's head.
  • The Meltagun is also extremely effective against a variety of enemy structures such as Shrieker Nests, Spore Spewers, and Command Bunkers, destroying them all in one shot.
    • All enemy spawners (besides Bug Holes) can be destroyed with 1 to 2 bursts of the Meltagun.
      • Grounded Warp Ships will require 3 bursts if the energy shield is deployed, one burst being used to take down the shield.

Trivia

  • The 40-K Meltagun, despite being based on the Warhammer 40,000 Meltagun and sharing its appearance, is notably smaller in game than it is on miniatures. The size of it is more akin to the Melta Carbine.
  • The producer of this weapon is ST Construction, referencing the Warhammer 40,000 Standard Template Constructs. These STC Systems are equivalent to technological time capsules, serving to preserve blueprints and knowledge from the Dark Age of Technology.
